title: Alpha or Factor Exposure? A Replication of Fama and French (1993) and a Factor-Neutrality Test of Industry Momentum, 1963-2026
description: Reproducible research code, paper, figures and tables. Replicates the core time-series evidence of Fama and French (1993) from public data and tests whether an industry-momentum strategy earns alpha or factor premia (CAPM, FF3, FF5, UMD), with out-of-sample, cost, regime, international and multiple-testing analyses.
